name: Don't Wake The Police!
desc:
Shhh... Don't wake the Police Officers! 🚔

How to Play : 
- Sneak around and steal Cars while they sleep! 😴
- Drive back to your plot as soon as you wake them up! 🚗
- Survive and collect as many Cars as possible! ⚡

Your cars earn money OFFLINE! 💤💰
👍 Like and Favorite the game for more updates ⭐️
